name: Abate AS Industries Limited
about: Abate AS Industries Limited provides eye healthcare services in India. The company offers eye care services through hospitals; and eyewear and vision solutions through optical outlet. It also provides professional courses in healthcare, architecture, and business through educational institutions. In addition, the company offers business advisory services comprising public listing support, such as BSE acquisition and compliance guidance; creative and practical architectural consultancy services; and marketing consultancy services. Further, it is involved in the operation of private university, wholesale retail mobile accessory outlet, and departmental stores; and develops real estate projects. The company was formerly known as Trijal Industries Limited. Abate AS Industries Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Perinthalmanna, India.
